title: Shipping Info
intro: Delivery details, all in one place.

sections.title: Delivery in Uganda
sections.html:
MPWR currently sells and delivers only within Uganda. International orders and delivery are not offered.

Enter your district and delivery address at checkout. Your delivery fee and estimated delivery window appear before you continue to payment.

The fee depends on your district and the items in your order. The total shown at checkout includes delivery.

sections.title: Check your district
sections.html:
Choose a district to see the starting fee and estimated delivery time.

This is an estimate. Your order’s final delivery charge and delivery window are shown at checkout.

sections.title: Getting your address ready
sections.html:
Include your street, building or a useful landmark, city or town, district, and a phone number. Use delivery notes for directions that help locate your address.

You can save addresses in your account and choose a default for future orders.

sections.title: After placing an order
sections.html: Open Order Status to see progress and any delivery updates recorded for your order. Delivery estimates are estimates rather than guaranteed arrival dates.

title: Return Policy
intro: A little clarity when something is not quite right.

sections.title: Your statutory rights come first
sections.html: The item-condition and hygiene rules below apply to MPWR’s voluntary return offer. They must not be used to deny a statutory cancellation or other mandatory remedy. You can notify MPWR directly without waiting for an in-app approval. See Cancellation and consumer rights.

sections.title: Request a return within 7 days
sections.html:
Contact MPWR within 7 calendar days after receiving your order to request a change-of-mind return. Include your order reference, the item, delivery date, and reason for returning it.

For a change-of-mind return, keep the item unused, unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging with its accessories and any hygiene seals intact.

sections.title: Beauty and hygiene conditions
sections.html:
Our change-of-mind return offer excludes used or opened lashes, nail products, cosmetics, and other items whose hygiene seal has been broken. Wigs should not have been worn, installed, cut, coloured, washed, or altered. Personalised items are excluded from this voluntary offer unless we agree otherwise.

These conditions do not remove any right you have under applicable law, including rights relating to faulty, incorrect, or misdescribed goods.

sections.title: Damaged, incorrect, or missing items
sections.html:
Contact us as soon as you notice a problem. Send your order reference, a description, and clear photos where available. Keep the packaging so we can investigate. The 7-day change-of-mind window does not limit your legal rights for faulty or misdescribed goods.

We will review the issue with you and arrange the appropriate remedy, which may include a replacement or refund.

sections.title: How to return an item
sections.html:
1. Email or WhatsApp MPWR with your order reference and item details.
  2. We will confirm the return instructions and the address to use. Your right to notify us of a cancellation is not dependent on our reply.
  3. For our voluntary return offer, send the item within 14 calendar days of receiving the instructions, unless we agree otherwise.
  4. Keep proof of dispatch until the return is resolved.

Please use the return address we confirm, rather than an address printed on a delivery package.

sections.title: Return delivery costs
sections.html: For a change-of-mind return, you pay the direct cost of returning the item. We do not charge a restocking fee. If MPWR sent the wrong item or the item is faulty, we will arrange the return or agree reasonable return-delivery costs with you.

sections.title: Cancellation and your rights
sections.html:
Use the cancellation action on an eligible Pending order, or contact us promptly if it is unavailable. A request submitted through the order page is reviewed by MPWR. This workflow does not replace any cancellation right under Ugandan law.

Nothing in this policy limits a mandatory consumer right. Where the law gives you a stronger right or a different deadline, that right or deadline applies.

title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
intro: Understand the information used when you shop with MPWR.

sections.title: Who to contact
sections.html: MPWR, located at Kisaasi, Bahai Road, is responsible for the account and shopping information described here. For privacy questions or requests, email kahumajk@gmail.com or call +256 752 296121.

sections.title: Your account and purchases
sections.html:
Account records include your name, email, password hash, contact details, profile picture if supplied, saved addresses and payment preferences. Orders include items and selected options, totals, delivery information, payment references and status. We also keep reviews, feedback, account appeals, privacy requests and the version and time of terms acceptance.

Name, email and authentication details are needed for an account; order and delivery details are needed to fulfil a purchase. A profile image, review, feedback rating, optional browsing history and optional cookie categories are discretionary. Without an optional category, its related browsing feature may be unavailable; essential checkout remains available.

sections.title: Payment information
sections.html:
Payment authorization takes place through the payment provider’s checkout. MPWR records order totals, payment status, and transaction references to match payments to orders.

Saved payment preferences can include a Mobile Money number or a card label and last four digits. MPWR’s checkout does not collect your full card number, PIN, or card security code.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.html:
MPWR uses a session cookie for sign-in and browser storage for shopping features. Strictly necessary storage supports your session, cart, checkout, account services you request, and your cookie choices.

Optional categories start off until you enable them. Performance controls optional search analytics and attribution. Functional controls recent searches, recently viewed products, and saved catalogue ordering. Targeting & personalization controls local product-interaction signals used for recommendations. MPWR currently does not load third-party advertising trackers.

Manage your cookie preferences to enable, reject, or withdraw optional categories. Changes apply when saved and are remembered on this browser for 180 days. They do not automatically follow you to another browser or device.

Turning a category off clears its associated optional history, identifiers, or recommendation signals on this browser. It does not erase analytics previously received or necessary order records. Cart items, wishlists, and saved account details remain available.

You can also manage site storage through your browser. Clearing all site data may sign you out or remove locally saved preferences. Optional categories return to off if your consent record is removed, expires, or cannot be read.

sections.title: Images and public reviews
sections.html:
Profile pictures and uploaded images are stored by MPWR’s media service. Product reviews, star ratings, purchased options, review images, and MPWR’s public replies may be visible to other shoppers.

Keep passwords, payment credentials, and private details out of reviews and uploaded images.

sections.title: Manage your information
sections.html: Use My Profile to update your account details, My Shipping Address to manage saved addresses, and My Payment Options to manage saved payment preferences. Your History page includes controls for clearing browsing entries.

sections.title: Why we use information
sections.html:
We use account, contact, and order information to provide the shopping services you request, process payments and deliveries, answer support requests, and protect accounts. With your optional cookie choices enabled, shopping activity helps us understand how the store is used and improve recommendations.

We rely on the applicable basis for each purpose, including providing your requested service, complying with legal duties, and consent where required. You can contact us to ask about a particular use or withdraw consent where the use depends on it.

sections.title: Service providers and transfers
sections.html:
Our integrations include Pesapal for payment processing, Resend for account emails, Cloudflare R2 for uploaded media, and Google Maps for supported address or distance services. The providers used depend on the feature and deployment. Delivery partners receive the contact, address and parcel details needed to deliver an order. Hosting, database and backup operators support the shop. Support through WhatsApp uses WhatsApp’s service.

Payment details entered on a provider’s checkout are also subject to that provider’s notice. Media links may be accessible to anyone with the link; do not upload confidential documents, payment credentials or identity documents to reviews or feedback.

Some providers operate outside Uganda. Ask MPWR for the recipients, locations and transfer arrangements relevant to your request. We do not describe an integration as certified or a transfer as approved merely because it is present in the website code.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.html:
Account information is retained while the account is used and reviewed when deletion is requested. Orders, payments, refunds and related complaint records can need longer retention for fulfilment, accounting, disputes or another applicable legal duty. A deletion outcome will identify any records retained and the reason; it is not a promise to erase every transaction immediately.

The sign-in session lasts up to seven days. Password-reset links expire after one hour and verification links after 24 hours. Cookie choices expire after 180 days. Optional history and recommendation storage is cleared on this browser when its category is disabled; otherwise it remains until cleared or the browser removes it. Local storage has no automatic browser expiry. Clearing a category does not delete server reports already received.

We use password hashing, authenticated account access and role restrictions. No internet service can guarantee absolute security. Contact MPWR about suspected unauthorized access. Retention and deletion of server records, media and backups requires review across the relevant systems; contact us for a record-specific explanation.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.html:
Request access, correction, deletion or review of an objection through Privacy requests or contact kahumajk@gmail.com or +256 752 296121. We may verify identity and redact information about other people. Access requests are handled promptly and within the applicable statutory period, normally no later than thirty days after receipt. We explain a refusal or a retention requirement.

You can withdraw optional browsing consent in Manage Cookies, object to direct marketing, and ask for human review of a decision affecting you. Recommendation sorting does not decide whether you are entitled to a legal remedy. You can complain to Uganda’s Personal Data Protection Office; contacting us first is not a waiver of that option.

sections.title: Children and marketing
sections.html:
The shop is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Do not create an account for a child or upload a child’s personal information. Contact us if such information has been submitted so we can review and remove it where appropriate.

Accepting shopping terms does not subscribe you to promotions. Service messages about your account, payment or order are separate from promotional messages. If you receive marketing from MPWR, you can ask us to stop it using the contact details above.

title: Refund
intro: Know what happens after a refund is agreed.

sections.title: When a refund applies
sections.html: Refunds may follow an approved return, an agreed resolution for faulty or incorrect goods, a cancelled paid order, or another situation where a refund is required by law. We will confirm the amount and the next steps with you.

sections.title: What is refunded
sections.html:
For a full qualifying cancellation, we refund the amount paid for the cancelled goods and the delivery charges refundable under applicable law. For a partial return, the refund reflects the amount actually paid for the returned items, including any discount.

For a change-of-mind return, the direct cost of returning the goods is your responsibility. We do not charge a restocking fee. Where MPWR is responsible for faulty or incorrect goods, agreed reasonable return costs are covered by MPWR.

sections.title: Where your refund goes
sections.html: Refunds are normally sent to the original payment method. If this is not possible, we will agree an alternative with you after confirming the payment and account details. Never share your PIN, password, card security code, or one-time authorization code with support.

sections.title: Processing times
sections.html:
We aim to initiate an agreed refund within one business day after the return has been checked or the cancellation has been confirmed. This is our service target; it does not extend a legal deadline. Where Uganda’s electronic-transaction cancellation rules apply, payment is refunded within 30 days of cancellation.

After initiation, Mobile Money refunds commonly take 1–3 business days. Card refunds commonly take 5–10 business days and can take up to 15. These are estimates, and provider processing can vary. Contact us if a refund has not arrived by the date shown for your order.

sections.title: Check your refund status
sections.html:
Open Order Status and find the relevant order. When a refund has been recorded, its panel shows the amount, destination, status, and any available reference or expected date.

Pending
Waiting to be initiated.
Initiated
Sent to the payment provider.
Processing
The provider is processing the refund.
Refunded
Marked complete.
Needs attention
The latest attempt needs investigation.

sections.title: Need help?
sections.html: Send your order reference and refund reference, if available, to MPWR. We will check the payment record and follow up on the next step. Nothing in this policy limits mandatory consumer rights.

title: Payment Method
intro: Choose how you would like to pay at checkout.

sections.title: Available options
sections.html:
• Credit or debit card — enter your card details on the payment provider’s checkout.
  • MTN MoMo — use your MTN Mobile Money number.
  • Airtel Money — use your Airtel Money number.

Your order total is shown in Ugandan shillings (USh). Available payment options are confirmed during secure payment.

sections.title: Complete secure payment
sections.html:
Review your contact details, delivery address, selected payment method, and order total. Choose Continue to secure payment and follow the payment provider’s authorization steps.

Return to MPWR when prompted, then check your payment result and Order Status. If the result is unclear, check the order before trying another payment.

sections.title: Saved payment preferences
sections.html: My Payment Options lets you save or remove payment preferences and set a default. Saving a preference does not make a payment; you still authorize payment when ordering.

title: Offers & Discounts
intro: Find the offers currently available at MPWR.

sections.title: Browse current offers
sections.html: Offer listings show discounted items and their current prices. Availability, options, and prices can change, so review the selected product and your order total before paying.

sections.title: Check your selected options
sections.html: A product’s price can depend on the option you choose, such as a wig’s length. Check the price after selecting your preferred option and quantity.

sections.title: At checkout
sections.html: Your order summary shows item prices, subtotal, delivery charge, and the total to pay. Use the current prices in your cart and checkout when reviewing an offer.

title: Review Guidance
intro: Share your experience and help other shoppers.

sections.title: Review a purchased item
sections.html:
1. Sign in to the account used for your purchase.
  2. Open My Purchases and select the Review tab.
  3. Choose Review item for an eligible purchase.
  4. Choose a star rating, add a comment, and post your review.

Product reviews are available for purchased items. Cancelled and returned orders are excluded from review eligibility.

sections.title: Add useful details
sections.html:
Describe the item you received and your experience using it. Details about the selected size, length, colour, or finish can help other shoppers choose.

You can add up to five JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF photos, each up to 5 MB. Use clear images that you have permission to share.

sections.title: Keep personal details private
sections.html: Your product review may be publicly visible. Leave out contact details, payment information, passwords, and other people’s private information.

sections.title: Website suggestions
sections.html: Use Feedback & Rating for suggestions about finding products, product information, checkout, and website errors. Product reviews are for your experience with the item itself.

title: How To Track My Order
intro: Your order’s progress is in your account.

sections.title: Find your order
sections.html:
1. Sign in to the account you used when placing the order.
  2. Open My Account and select Order Status.
  3. Find your order using its items, date, or reference.
  4. Read the status and the delivery updates shown on the order.

sections.title: What the status means
sections.html:
Pending
The order is awaiting the next processing step. Check its payment information as well.
Processing
The order is being prepared.
Shipped
The order has moved to delivery.
Delivered
The order is marked as delivered.
Cancelled or Returned
Check the order details and any refund panel for further information.

sections.title: Delivery updates
sections.html: The order page shows tracking details when they have been added to your order. Check it again for the latest recorded update.

title: How To Order
intro: From finding your favourites to completing payment.

sections.title: 1. Find your item
sections.html: Browse wigs, press-on nails, lashes, and other available products. Open an item to see its description, images, available options, price, and customer reviews.

sections.title: 2. Make it yours
sections.html: Select the available options you want, choose a quantity, and add the item to your cart. Check the selected options and price in your cart before continuing.

sections.title: 3. Add your delivery details
sections.html: Sign in and open checkout from your cart. Enter your contact information, address, city or town, and district. Check the delivery fee and estimate before proceeding.

sections.title: 4. Review and pay
sections.html: Choose card, MTN MoMo, or Airtel Money. Review your items and the full total, then choose Continue to secure payment. Follow the payment provider’s prompts to authorize the transaction.

sections.title: 5. Follow your order
sections.html: Return to MPWR after payment. Use Order Status to check the payment and order progress. Your purchases also appear in My Purchases.

sections.html:
These terms apply to MPWR’s online shop and orders placed through it. MPWR currently sells and delivers only within Uganda. International orders and delivery are not offered. Read the Shipping Info, Return Policy, Refund and Privacy & Cookie Policy before ordering. Product-specific information shown before purchase forms part of your order.

Signup and checkout ask you to agree to this version. Agreement to shopping terms does not enable optional cookies or subscribe you to marketing. Save or print these pages for your records.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and eligibility
sections.html:
Create and use an account only if you are 18 or older and able to enter into a purchase agreement. An adult should place an order on behalf of a younger person using the adult’s own account and payment authority. Do not send us a child’s personal information in reviews or uploads.

Give accurate contact details, keep your password private and use only payment methods you are authorized to use. Contact us promptly about suspected unauthorized access. You can correct your profile, saved addresses and payment preferences in your account.

sections.title: 4. Products, options and care
sections.html:
Check the description, material, size or length, colour, included items and care instructions for the exact option you select. Screen colours and styling photographs may differ from the appearance on your device. This does not excuse a material mismatch with the description.

Ask us about information that is missing before ordering. Follow supplied product instructions; stop using a cosmetic or adhesive if it causes irritation and seek appropriate advice. No general health or performance guarantee is made beyond the product information and rights that apply to your purchase.

sections.title: 5. Prices and offers
sections.html:
Prices are in Ugandan shillings (UGX). Review the item prices, quantities, delivery fee and final total at checkout. MPWR will not add a new charge to a completed order without your agreement. Offer conditions, eligibility and expiry are shown with an offer; an offer is not transferable or combinable unless stated.

If a price or stock error affects your order, we will contact you with the available options. We will not substitute a different item or charge a higher price without your agreement. If we cannot supply a paid item, we will refund it.

sections.title: 6. Reviewing and placing an order
sections.html:
Before continuing to secure payment, check your bag, product options, quantities, address, contact information, delivery estimate and total. You can edit your bag or leave checkout before submitting. A pending order reference records the request; it does not by itself confirm successful payment or dispatch.

Payment status and fulfilment status are shown in My Purchases. Contact us if a payment succeeds but the order does not update. Keep the order reference and payment receipt. If we cannot fulfil an order, we will notify you and arrange the appropriate refund.

sections.title: 7. Payment security
sections.html:
Card and Mobile Money authorization takes place through the payment provider. MPWR’s checkout does not collect your full card number, card security code or Mobile Money PIN. Never send these details in feedback, email, WhatsApp or a review. Saved payment preferences are labels, limited card details or Mobile Money details, not a standing authorization to take new payments.

Your bank or mobile provider may apply its own disclosed charges and processing times. A payment failure does not authorize duplicate collection. Contact MPWR if you see a duplicate payment.

sections.title: 8. Delivery and delays
sections.html:
Checkout displays the delivery district, charge and estimated timeframe. Give a complete address and a reachable phone number. Tell us promptly if you need to correct the address; changes after dispatch may require new arrangements, which we will explain before any additional charge.

Contact us about a late, missing, damaged or wrongly delivered parcel. A delivery status alone does not prevent you from disputing receipt. We will investigate with the delivery partner and discuss the remedy. Delay notices do not remove cancellation or refund rights.

sections.title: 9. Cancellation and consumer rights
sections.html:
Uganda’s Electronic Transactions Act provides seven-day cancellation rights and refunds within thirty days of qualifying cancellation. It also provides remedies for missing required disclosures and late or unavailable supply. Statutory rights take priority over these terms, return conditions and website status controls.

You may notify cancellation by email or WhatsApp using your order reference. A website approval step is an administrative process, not a condition that removes a legal right. See the Return Policy and Refund page for instructions.

sections.title: 10. Change-of-mind returns and problems with goods
sections.html:
Our separate voluntary return offer has a seven-calendar-day request window and item-condition requirements. Its hygiene and personalized-item exclusions apply to that offer only. They do not automatically exclude statutory cancellation, faulty-goods or misdescription remedies.

For a wrong, defective or missing item, contact us with the order reference and the available details. Photos can help an investigation, but a review or photo is not a universal condition for exercising a legal right. Do not continue using an item if that could make a safety problem worse.

sections.title: 11. Refunds
sections.html: The Refund page explains the method, service targets, provider processing estimates and how to follow up. Approval in an order screen does not mean money has already arrived. We will not replace a monetary refund with store credit unless you choose it. For returns involving our error, we will agree appropriate return arrangements with you.

sections.title: 12. Reviews, ratings and uploads
sections.html:
Post honest reviews about your experience and only upload material you have the right to share. Keep private details, account credentials and other people’s images out of submissions unless you have permission. Feedback sent through the feedback form is intended for MPWR’s team; product reviews and their attachments can be public.

You keep ownership of your content. You give MPWR a non-exclusive permission to host, format and display a public review with the relevant product and respond to it. This does not authorize unrelated advertising use of your photograph. Contact us to request correction or removal. We may remove unlawful, abusive, spam or misleading submissions; disagreement or a low rating alone is not a reason to remove an honest review.

sections.title: 13. Acceptable use and account restrictions
sections.html: Do not attempt unauthorized access, disrupt the shop, submit malicious files, impersonate another person, manipulate reviews or misuse payments. We may restrict an account to investigate suspected misuse or protect customers. You can contact support or use the account appeal route to challenge a restriction. A restriction does not remove your rights relating to existing orders, refunds or your personal information.

sections.title: 14. Privacy and account deletion
sections.html:
The Privacy & Cookie Policy explains the information used for accounts, payments, delivery, support and optional browsing features. You can refuse optional cookies while using essential shopping services.

Use Privacy requests to ask for access, correction, deletion or an objection review. Account deletion is a reviewed request, not instant erasure of transaction records. We explain retained records and reasons in the outcome. Submitting it does not cancel an order or waive a refund.

sections.title: 15. Site availability and responsibility
sections.html: We aim to keep the shop accurate and available, but maintenance and faults can interrupt access. If an interruption affects a payment or order, contact us rather than repeatedly paying. MPWR remains responsible for its obligations under your purchase and applicable law. These terms do not impose a blanket exclusion of liability, a compulsory waiver or a cap on mandatory consumer remedies.

sections.title: 16. Complaints and disputes
sections.html:
Send a complaint to kahumajk@gmail.com or +256 752 296121, with the order or request reference, what happened and the outcome you seek. Do not include payment credentials. Our service target is to acknowledge complaints within two working days; statutory response duties continue to apply regardless of that target.

Ugandan law governs these terms, subject to any mandatory protections that apply. You remain free to approach a competent regulator, obtain independent advice or pursue a remedy through a court with jurisdiction. No compulsory private arbitration is required by these terms.

sections.title: 17. Versions and records
sections.html:
This is version 2026-10-17.2, effective 17 October 2026. We record the version and time of acceptance at signup and when a new order is submitted. A copy of this policy bundle is available in the policy archive.

Changes apply prospectively and do not remove rights or change the agreed terms of a past purchase. Material updates require a new version at signup and checkout. Download or print your order record while your account is available, or request a copy from MPWR.
